reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getAverageFillCategories selection and the sign from spendingToBudgetAmount, plus getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages and the standard mutator(undoable(...)) registration.

duplication.why: No selection or sign logic is copied; the new action only composes shared helpers with its one-month lookup.

placement.why: The action sits beside the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the action, its handler type/registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short, consistent with its neighbours, and future changes to the category policy or sign rule reach it automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getAverageFillCategories and spendingToBudgetAmount rather than its own query or sign flip.
